defects.defect: Only one mage is present in the camp area (lone hooded figure at x≈530,y≈1000); the spec calls for three mages at the camp ledge, and the melee unit fighting at x≈265,y≈540 is a warrior, not a mage trio
defects.direction: Place all three mage sprites (Bastion, Ember, Sage) staged on the camp ledge so the HUD cards map 1:1 to visible units

defects.defect: A tall empty flat-brown band sits under the sand ledge with no dressing, and the sand play area does not span the full device width — cream letterbox strips are visible at x≈0-40 and x≈690-724
defects.direction: Extend the arena art edge-to-edge and either fill the lower brown band with painted foreground terrain or shrink it so the arena meets the HUD
defects.region: arena bottom, brown band between ledge and HUD (y≈1100-1240)

defects.defect: Damage/heal numbers stack over character faces and each other, making the combat feedback hard to read.
defects.direction: Stagger floating numbers vertically and laterally, with stronger contrast and collision avoidance.

defects.defect: Damage/heal numbers ('50', '13', '+54') are small, low-contrast and overlap each other and the hero sprite; the grey '50' nearly vanishes against sand
defects.direction: Increase font size, add a dark outline/drop shadow, and offset stacked numbers vertically so they never overlap sprites or each other
defects.region: floating combat numbers near x≈180-290, y≈420-520

defects.defect: Speed toggle and pause buttons overhang the cream title bar and bleed past its top/left edges, and the 1x chip is a plain flat rectangle while pause is an ornate round frame — inconsistent control styling
defects.direction: Inset both controls within the title bar with equal margins and give the speed toggle the same ornate round/pill frame treatment as pause
defects.region: top strip, 1x button x≈20-105 and pause x≈620-700, y≈220-300

defects.defect: All three hero cards use the same tiny grey-robed mage sprite as the portrait even though Bastion is rendered in-arena as a red-haired dwarf with shield
defects.direction: Give each card a distinct portrait matching that hero's arena sprite
defects.region: bottom HUD, all three portrait rings

defects.defect: Only one hooded mage is visibly staged near the camp; the intended three-mage camp composition is not legible.
defects.direction: Place all three hero identities clearly around the camp ledge with distinct silhouettes.

defects.defect: Spec calls for three mages defending at the camp ledge; only one robed mage stands near the camp, a second hero (dwarf) is far upfield in the goblin spawn area, and a third hero is not visible at all
defects.direction: Place all three party heroes together near the camp ledge with the goblins advancing down toward them

defects.defect: The hero and goblin sprites collapse into one dense overlap, obscuring combat silhouettes and who is attacking whom.
defects.direction: Separate combatants with clearer lanes and preserve visible sprite outlines.

defects.defect: The stage track rail is drawn on top of / clipped by the arena's left edge and its nodes are half-cut by the sand panel; the active node (yellow, y≈865) reads as third from bottom rather than stage 2/4, and node spacing is uneven (gaps 235/235/240 vs bottom node crowding)
defects.direction: Move the track fully outside the arena bounds in its own gutter, evenly space the four nodes, and highlight the node matching Stage 2/4

defects.defect: Three goblins and the hero overlap heavily and share ambiguous ground shadows; the archer goblin's bow/quiver is occluded and depth ordering reads flat
defects.direction: Spread advancing goblins into a staggered formation with clear separation and consistent per-sprite ground shadows

defects.defect: Damage/heal numbers ('13', '+54', faded '50') are small and low-contrast against sprites and sand, hurting readability
defects.direction: Enlarge the numbers, add a stronger outline/drop shadow, and float them clear of sprite overlap
defects.region: damage numbers over melee cluster, upper arena

defects.defect: Name spacing is inconsistent — 'Bastion' has a gap after its portrait while 'Ember' and 'Sage' butt directly against theirs
defects.direction: Use one consistent portrait-to-name gap across all three cards
defects.region: HUD cards: name labels next to portraits

defects.defect: Card columns are not evenly distributed: left gutter ≈40px, right gutter ≈44px but inter-card gaps ≈67px, and HP bars have differing widths (Bastion 40-212, Ember 277-445, Sage 511-680)
defects.direction: Use a uniform 3-column grid with equal gutters and identical HP-bar widths per card

defects.defect: Hero sprites are very small inside their ornate rings, leaving the ring mostly empty

defects.region: HUD portrait rings, all three cards

defects.defect: Gear tiles are inconsistent — Bastion's tiles sit at x≈40-208 while Sage's run x≈510-680, and the icon art styles mix (flat grey armor vs saturated painted robes), so tiles do not read as one set

defects.region: HUD gear tiles, y≈1395-1460 across all three cards

defects.defect: The stage track reads as a detached vertical control with ambiguous progression states.
defects.direction: Clarify active/completed nodes and visually integrate the track with the battlefield frame.
